card.line: Laodicea was a rich city in Asia Minor with a church that Paul prayed for and that Jesus later rebuked and invited to open the door to Him.

moments.title: Paul struggles for Laodicea
moments.text: Paul says he is struggling for the believers at Laodicea, even those who have never met him. He wants them encouraged in heart and knit together in love.

moments.title: Greetings and a shared letter
moments.text: Paul sends greetings to the brothers in Laodicea. He tells the Colossians to make sure his letter is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and to read the letter from Laodicea.

moments.title: Laodicea named among seven churches
moments.text: Jesus tells John to write what he sees and send it to seven churches. Laodicea is the last one on the list.

moments.title: Jesus' message to Laodicea
moments.text: Jesus says the church is lukewarm, and that it thinks it is rich but is really poor and blind. He rebukes those He loves, then says He stands at the door and knocks.
